title: Nice Valentine Decor
text: Nice Valentine Decor. I originally ordered these Valentine's gnomes for my tiered tray. However, when I saw them, I decided to do something else with them. My elderly father lives in an assisted living home. These will be perfect for him! He has a small shelf outside his room. Most of the residents use it for decor. I've been getting him something for each month either seasonal or holiday related. Valentine's Day is a harder season in my opinion. These gnomes will look great! Plus they're soft and if he bumps into the shelf and knocks them down, it won't cause a mess or damage the items. They are well made. The bottoms are weighted so they won't topple over. I did try them on my tiered tray. They are too tall for the lower levels, but look nice on the top layer. I may order another set for myself!
